store-read-forward-aba.summary: sidecar_read_store_record_at reads a relocated store record A in three fixes. Between them, A's stamp rolls back and its forward slot F becomes REC_DELETED_WILL_REUSE; a stamp of another store record B relocates B into F; the read copies B's REC_NEWHOME bytes from F; B leaves F (rollback, or commit and vacuum); a new stamp of A relocates A into F again; the home recheck sees REC_RELOCATION to F and returns B's bytes as A's value. sidecar_store_value checks only the attribute id and the length.
store-read-forward-aba.fix: Not fixed. The model passes when a freed forward slot is never handed out again (--set fwd_slot_reuse=no). Other candidates, not modeled: a recheck that also proves the forward record is A's, or holding the home page while the forward page is read (two store pages, I-7).

store-read-reread-bound.summary: A read of a relocated store record that changes under it at every round gives up after SIDECAR_REREAD_BOUND rounds and reports the record absent. Each round needs one stamp of A that relocates it and rolls back during the read. A protected reader or a lock holder then fails with ER_SIDECAR_DANGLING_REF for a live value; a committed-snapshot reader retries.
store-read-reread-bound.fix: Accepted bound (sidecar.cpp marks it a guess). It needs SIDECAR_REREAD_BOUND writers of the same row that each relocate the store record and roll back while one read runs. The property passes with fewer stamp cycles (model.stamp_cycles=below_reread_bound).
